description: Source code for the RemoteControl plugin in a WPEFramework-based project, implementing remote control functionalities with IARM bus communication, event handling, and JSON-RPC methods.

classes.name: RemoteControl
classes.description: Main class implementing remote control functionalities, event handling, and JSON-RPC interface.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number of the plugin.

methods.name: startPairing
methods.description: Initiates remote pairing process via IARM bus call.

methods.name: stopPairing
methods.description: Stops remote pairing process via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getNetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves network status via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getIRDBManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches IR database manufacturers, possibly from cloud, via IARM bus call with increased timeout.

methods.name: getIRDBModels
methods.description: Fetches IR database models, possibly from cloud, via IARM bus call with increased timeout.

methods.name: getIRCodesByAutoLookup
methods.description: Performs IR code auto-lookup via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getIRCodesByNames
methods.description: Retrieves IR codes by names via IARM bus call.

methods.name: setIRCode
methods.description: Sets an IR code via IARM bus call.

methods.name: clearIRCodes
methods.description: Clears IR codes via IARM bus call.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Gets the source of the last keypress via IARM bus call.

methods.name: configureWakeupKeys
methods.description: Configures wakeup keys via IARM bus call.

methods.name: initializeIRDB
methods.description: Initializes IR database via IARM bus call.

methods.name: findMyRemote
methods.description: Finds the remote via IARM bus call.

methods.name: factoryReset
methods.description: Performs factory reset via IARM bus call with extended timeout.

methods.name: unpair
methods.description: Unpairs remote via IARM bus call.

methods.name: startFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Starts firmware update via IARM bus call.

methods.name: cancelFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Cancels firmware update via IARM bus call.

methods.name: statusFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Checks firmware update status via IARM bus call.

methods.name: onStatus
methods.description: Handles status events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onFirmwareUpdateProgress
methods.description: Handles firmware update progress events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onValidation
methods.description: Handles validation events and sends notifications.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the internal API version number.
